source.title: Variability of the Pacific North Equatorial Current from 1993 to 2012 based on a 1/8 degree Pacific model simulation
source.reviewed_material: Primary publisher full text, especially sections2.1,4 and Figure4 caption. Figure image and original PDF not yet individually reviewed.

dimension_lead.vertical_support: At the surface; the exact model surface level and contour/operator require original figure/method review.
dimension_lead.time_support: Mean simulated zonal velocity over1993-2012, not an instantaneous width or seasonal range.

scope_separations: The study's6-21N and0-1200m transport integration limits are analysis bounds, not current width or uniform current thickness.
The reported8.5-15N band above0.10m/s is a speed-threshold region; its vertical support must be resolved before treating it as a surface core width.
The northern extension near25N at600m is distinct from the surface span and cannot extend its northern edge.
The simulated mean1993-2012 field and the Argo geostrophic comparison must remain distinct evidence products.
A width of the time-mean velocity field is not a mean or annual range of instantaneous widths.
The section is cross-current support, not an along-current axis or whole-current length.

source_discrepancy_to_resolve.handling: Preserve the discrepancy. Only137E is a candidate here; do not silently pick150E or156E.

related_primary_project_synthesis.title: The Pacific North Equatorial Current: New Insights from the Origins of the Kuroshio and Mindanao Currents (OKMC) Project
related_primary_project_synthesis.lead: Printed page25 distinguishes a nominal west-of-dateline surface band from deeper poleward extent. This is separate source and layer support, not an uncertainty interval around the2017 model result.

Audit existing family-scoped evidence by source DOI and operator before admitting any member record; avoid duplicating or silently transferring historical family records.
If supported, derive the cross-section meridional distance under the established geodesic convention with source precision retained, and create a compact native diagram.
Keep whole-current length, annual ranges and numerical uncertainty unknown until separately supported.
